title: Biomedical Engineering, Minor (College of Engineering)
notes: 18cr bulletin match at the floor of the stated 18-20cr range, computed 35cr against CMPSC after a real hidden-prereq chain. Minor code BMEMIN chosen to avoid colliding with the already-built Biomedical Engineering major (code BME). Physiology component (select one) -- filled with BIOL 141 (prereq-free), avoiding BIOL 240W (needs BIOL 110 + CHEM 110) and BIOL 472 (needs one of several intro bio courses). Molecular/Cell Biology component (select one) -- filled with BME 201, whose own prereq_groups require BIOL 141 (already selected above) AND CHEM 112 AND MATH 141 -- picked over BMB 251 (needs CHEM 112 or MICRB 201) specifically because BME 201 is the option the paired BME major's own flowchart already requires. Supporting Courses (12cr, the bulletin restricts this pool to '3-credit courses at the 400 or 500 level' BME coursework specifically) -- filled with BME 401 + BME 437 + BME 450W (all three prereq-free) + BME 409 (needs MATH 230 + MATH 251, both satisfied via the MATH 141 already pulled in for BME 201). Real hidden-prereq chain for the CMPSC pairing: BME 201's CHEM 112 requirement needs CHEM 110 (itself needing MATH 22, itself needing MATH 21) plus CHEM 111 concurrently with CHEM 110 -- the same MATH-21-placement-gate pattern documented repeatedly across this project; MATH 141 and MATH 230/251 were NOT added as extra hidden-prereq items since CMPSC's own required flowchart already includes MATH 140/141/230, and MATH 251 needs only MATH 141 (already covered). Added CHEM 110 + CHEM 111 + CHEM 112 + MATH 21 + MATH 22 + MATH 251 explicitly (17cr) for the CMPSC pairing only. Verified against CMPSC (this catalog's standard baseline) -- plan_progress confirms exactly 35.0cr for the minor:BMEMIN bucket, since the 6 hidden-prereq items were encoded as explicit requirements inside this minor's own file (same approach as MARSCIMIN's BIOL 110 addition), so they count toward the minor's own bucket total rather than a separate one. Also verified against the paired BME major, which already independently requires BIOL 141, BME 201, BME 401, BME 450W, CHEM 110/111/112, MATH 140/141/230/251, PHYS 211/212, and CMPSC 200 on its own flowchart; plan_progress still reports the same 35.0cr for the minor:BMEMIN bucket there too (bucket totals reflect this minor's own requirement list regardless of major overlap) -- the real-world uniqueness value is in the underlying courses, not the bucket total: only BME 437 and BME 409 (6cr) are courses a real BME-major student wouldn't already be taking, matching the bulletin's own stated 'at least six credits of the minor must be unique from the student's major(s)' rule almost exactly, unlike several of this project's other near-total-overlap engineering-minor pairings (e.g. MINEMIN/MINE).
